definitions.explanation: A mechanical or electromechanical machine for writing characters by pressing keys that cause inked types to strike paper. Largely replaced by computers but still used in some contexts.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{昔|むかし}タイプライターで{手紙|てがみ}を{打|う}っていた。
examples.english: My grandfather used to type letters on a typewriter.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}いタイプライターが{骨董品|こっとうひん}として{売|う}られている。
examples.english: Old typewriters are being sold as antiques.

examples.japanese: タイプライターの{音|おと}がカタカタと{響|ひび}いた。
examples.english: The sound of the typewriter clattered.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: From English 'typewriter'.

USAGE: While largely obsolete due to computers, typewriters are still:
・Collected as antiques
・Used for certain official documents in some countries
・Appreciated for aesthetic/nostalgic value

RELATED VOCABULARY:
・{和文|わぶん}タイプライター (Japanese typewriter)
・タイプを{打|う}つ (to type)
・ワープロ (word processor - abbreviation of ワードプロセッサー)

NOTE: Japanese typewriters were complex mechanical devices with thousands of characters, unlike Western typewriters.
